population: Eligible paid channel members and opt-in test participants in individual owner-authorized channels; trial-only users, lapsed viewers and nonpayers are distinct

definition_rules.rule: Total members may include canceled subscribers with remaining perks; active members exclude canceled subscriptions. Neither snapshot is necessarily a matched eligible-to-renew cohort.
Members Lost counts canceled members after perk access ends. It is not identical to Members Canceled in a same-date snapshot.
Transactions may contain first-time charges and recurrences; total transaction count alone cannot measure renewal propensity.
Billing periods can vary with calendar month (28, 30 or 31 days). Do not divide a rolling 28-day viewer audience into billing-cycle renewals.
Trial-only and gifted member activity is not proof of a settled recurring paid renewal; use explicit event classification.
Canceled access can outlive cancellation and refunded transactions can reduce creator receipts; preserve refund/charge reversal separately.

cohort_event_requirements: Channel-owner authorization and no exposed personal IDs
A documented consent and privacy-safe aggregate extraction procedure
Cohort ID and enrollment date window with membership tier, geography and billing provider as permitted
Actual renewal due windows, not presumed 30-day cycles
Explicit renewal outcome partition: settled paid, not renewed, unresolved
Trial-only, gifted and newly subscribed persons excluded from the paid renewal due denominator unless separately qualified
Date of refunds and their possible adjustments to cash payout, recorded independently
Right-censoring and missing outcomes reported, not imputed as churn

offer_test_design.hypothesis: Specific membership perks or creator products address a preregistered, documented audience need; purchase and repeat payment remain hypotheses until observed.
offer_test_design.comparison_unit: One consenting creator channel and one audience segment per prespecified period; no cross-format mixing without stratification.

candidate_variants.description: Existing offer and perk package without change
An explicitly designed low-delivery-cost perk package with disclosed benefits

preregister_before_launch: Audience need, channel, eligible country and age safeguards
Displayed country-specific buyer price and payment provider
Enrollment method and whether control and treatment are comparable
Primary settled-paid conversion denominator, cohort entry and renewal due windows
Cash budget, labor hours, explicit stop loss and review date chosen by creator
Safety and policy review, including refunds, child-directed restrictions and privacy
Minimum effect or cost ceiling judged worthwhile before viewing results
decision_rules: Continue only if prespecified net cash and time thresholds are satisfied with attributable supported evidence.
Report underpowered, incomplete or incompatible cohorts as inconclusive, not successes.
Do not infer causal offer effect from one before/after channel period or a self-selected experiment.
Respect all participant permission boundaries; no buyer-level personal data in public Mercata.
